Thus we need to call get_flight_cost, then compute_exchange_rate. Then respond with cost in EUR.

But the enum for location includes "Rome". But we need 3-letter code. Let's assume "FCO".

So call get_flight_cost with travel_from="SFO", travel_to="FCO", travel_date="2024-10-10", travel_class="business".

Then compute_exchange_rate with base_currency="USD", target_currency="EUR", value=cost.

Let's do that.
